ammonia.reason: No bloomy/washed rind urease activity; 90-day hard interior has low volatile NH3 from deamination.

animal_barnyard.reason: p-cresol/indole not detected; pasteurized milk and clean LAB fermentation limit phenolic defects.

bitter.reason: Lactobacillus helveticus peptidases debitter hydrophobic rennet peptides during 3-month ripening.

blue_moldy.reason: Low 2-heptanone/2-nonanone 0.02-0.56 mg/kg from fatty-acid beta-oxidation, no Penicillium roqueforti.

browning.reason: Maillard between residual galactose and amino acids plus fat browning on heating of low-moisture paste.

buttery.reason: Low diacetyl 0.007-0.031 mg/kg plus acetoin 0.08-0.40 mg/kg from citrate/pyruvate metabolism by starter LAB.

cheesy_sweaty.reason: Moderate butanoic 0.3-1.5 mg/kg plus hexanoic/octanoic acids from lipase/esterase lipolysis of milk fat.

creaminess.reason: Fat ~31-33% wet, ~48-51% FDM lubricates mouthfeel despite firm cooked pressed matrix.

crumbliness.reason: Elastic cooked propionic-eyed paste retains colloidal calcium phosphate at pH ~5.65, fractures little.

firmness.reason: Cooked 50-52C, pressed, brined, moisture ~35% and 90-day aging gives firm elastic Gruyere-type body.

floral_honey.reason: Phenylacetaldehyde/2-phenylethanol not detected; only low benzoic acid 3-34 mg/kg from phenylalanine.

fruity.reason: Ethyl butanoate up to 0.51 mg/kg and ethyl hexanoate up to 0.36 mg/kg from LAB esterase esterification.

goaty.reason: No 4-methyl/4-ethyloctanoic acids detected; only trace 3-methylbutanoic, short-chain acids low.

malty_nutty.reason: Signature sweet-nutty from Strecker 2-/3-methylbutanal plus propionic fermentation by Propionibacterium shermanii.

melt.reason: pH 5.6-5.7 demineralized para-casein with intact fat emulsion flows smoothly like alpine Gruyere-type.

mushroom_earthy.reason: 1-octen-3-ol/1-octen-3-one not detected; no mold rind lipoxygenase-linoleate pathway.

oil_off.reason: Moderate free-oil release on heating from ~50% FDM cooked curd, less than long-aged grana.

smoky.reason: No smoking step and guaiacol not detected; cooked curd has no wood-smoke phenols.

sour_vinegar.reason: pH ~5.6-5.7 with acetate up to ~1000 mg/kg by NMR from LAB/Propionibacterium, most lactose depleted.

stretch.reason: Rennet-coagulated non-pasta-filata curd with no hot-water kneading, so no aligned fibers for long stretch.

sulfur_cooked.reason: Only trace dimethyl sulfide 0.001-0.006 mg/kg; no methanethiol/DMDS, cooking drives off sulfides.

sweet.reason: Propionibacterium converts lactate to milder propionate plus proline/glycerol at low acidity perceived sweet.

umami.reason: 90-day rennet plus Lb. helveticus proteolysis releases glutamate peptides enhancing savory broth.
